Name: Stardew Valley Maps Retouched
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

The vanilla maps are well done in their own right, but after a while of modding, they can look completely barren. This mod strives to fix that by adding more trees, bushes, and grass to each map, making them seem more filled in and alive.

To clarify, this is NOT a recolor! You will need another mod for that!

I also retouched a few areas here and there, such as changing the stone tiles around JojaMart, lowering the amount of dirt in the Mountains and Railroad, extending the Secret Woods and adding more stumps, and redesigning the Summit to look more green.

[b]Note:[/b] Most Festival Maps are currently not included. I will be adding those at a later date. I also have no plans to do Beach or Desert Maps, as there's very little I can do with them.

[size=5]Mod Compatibility:[/size]

I tried not to add too many trees/bushes around areas where NPCs tend to hang out. That being said, due to the sheer number of mods out there, I can't account for every single one. There might be some mismatched tiles here and there from map patches added by other mods. Or there might be a tree in the way during certain cutscenes. I hope you've upgraded your Axe!

[size=4]By default, this mod is incompatible with Stardew Valley Expanded and will not work if you have SVE installed! This is due to the fact that SVE makes its own edits of vanilla maps.[/size]

[b]Mod authors who want to create a compatibility patch in their mod to work with mine are completely welcome to do so! No need to ask me for permission![/b]

[size=4]Confirmed Compatible:[/size]

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13057]Dusty Overhaul[/url]
[url=https://ko-fi.com/s/f5b179e3f1]Overgrown Valley[/url] (You will need to config that mod to work with this one)
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7332]Way Back Pelican Town[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44095]Gem Sea Shores[/url] (disable the Flower Dance map in this mod's config)

[size=5]Config Options:[/size]

Install the mod and run the game using SMAPI at least once in order to generate a config.json file.

All retouched maps can be toggled on and off individually for better compatibility with other mods. These maps are as follows:

Backwoods, Bus Stop, Forest, Mountain, Railroad, Town, Summit, and Secret Woods.

The following festival maps are also included, and they too can be configured on and off. However, their respective area (ex. Forest) must also be enabled for them to appear:

Flower Dance, Ice Festival

[size=5]Install:[/size]

[b]Note:[/b] If you are installing midsave, you WILL need to install Reset Terrain Features, otherwise you'll be missing the new retouches!

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (and optionally [url=https://github.com/Lake1059/ResetTerrainFeatures_NET6/releases]Reset Terrain Features[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6304]Destroyable Bushes[/url]).
- Copy [CP] Stardew Valley Maps Retouched into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

[size=5]Credits:[/size]

[url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BeazNees]BeazNees[/url] for making the Summit benches with their respective recolors and allowing me to use them!
